text: Thai Beverage PCL's FY2025 Annual Report register of substantial shareholders (as at 11 December 2025) lists Siriwana Co., Ltd. with 45.24% direct interest plus 20.60% deemed, and members of the Sirivadhanabhakdi family with deemed interests of 65.84% of the company.
short: ThaiBev is ~65.8% controlled by the Sirivadhanabhakdi family's companies (SGX-listed register).

source.name: Thai Beverage PCL Annual Report 2025 (SGXNet filing): Statistics of Shareholders, p. 127
source.note: From the 'Substantial Shareholders' table: Siriwana Co., Ltd. 11,368,060,000 (45.24%) direct; deemed interests of 65.84% are held via Siriwana/Siriwanan and related family companies. The same page states approximately 27.67% of shares are held by the public.
